name: Simulated county SES index for the OHDSI GIS tutorial
description: SIMULATED composite socioeconomic status index (0-100, higher = more affluent) for US counties, generated by the tutorial's synthetic data generator. It is correlated with county PM2.5 (about -0.3) so that SES confounds the PM2.5 effect. It is not a real county statistic. The index is static over 2014-2019 and is attached to the county polygons of the Census TIGER/Line 2023 counties.

about.name: ETL process for the simulated county SES index
about.description: The county SES index is drawn by the tutorial's data generator (deterministic per county FIPS code) and published as a two-column CSV (geoid, ses_index). It is loaded into PostGIS like the CDC PM2.5 dataset: the CSV is loaded into a temporary table, the county polygons of us_2023_county_tl are copied, and ses_index is joined to them on geoid.

variableMeasured.name: geoid
variableMeasured.description: Geographic identifier as five numeric characters (state and county FIPS)

variableMeasured.name: ses_index
variableMeasured.description: Simulated composite socioeconomic status index, 0-100, higher = more affluent. Static over 2014-2019.
